leftEvidence.title: Adam’s generations end with his death

points.label: Death stated
points.left: The genealogy recalls image, male and female, blessing, and the name Adam, then records Seth in Adam’s likeness, other children, nine hundred thirty years, and death.
points.right: Paul says all die in Adam and will be made alive in Christ, then orders resurrection, reign, enemies, death’s defeat, and final subjection.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Children, generations, and death · core · Genesis 5:1–5
points.right: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · 1 Corinthians 15:20–28

payload.posture: Adam’s years are counted and the record ends with his death is held beside All die in Adam and will be made alive in Christ in an ordered future.

rightEvidence.title: Death in Adam stands beside life in Christ

payload.tension: Genesis records one man’s death, while Corinthians speaks of all in Adam and a future made alive in Christ.
payload.title: Adam’s death and life in Christ
